sections.section_title: Section A: Fundamental Sports & Ball Skills

questions.instruction: Fill in the blanks with the correct word for each basic sports skill.

items.sentence: Always keep your __________ on the ball when catching it.
Use the inside of your __________ to kick the ball gently to a partner.
When throwing a ball with your right hand, step forward with your opposite __________.
Bending your __________ helps you jump higher and land safely without hurting yourself.
When catching a high ball, make a __________ shape with your thumbs and index fingers.

questions.instruction: Choose the correct option for each question about ball skills and movement.

items.question: Which ball is usually bounced on the court while playing?
What should you do with your hands when catching a fast-moving ball?
options: Close your eyes and turn away
Pull your hands back slightly to cushion the ball
Push your hands forward hard against the ball
items.answer: Pull your hands back slightly to cushion the ball

items.question: What is the correct way to strike a cricket ball with a bat?
options: Look at the sky while swinging
Keep your eyes on the ball until you hit it
Hold the bat with only one finger
items.answer: Keep your eyes on the ball until you hit it

sections.section_title: Section C: Yoga, Asanas & Daily Wellness

questions.instruction: Choose the correct option about basic Asanas, Pranayama, and healthy habits.

items.question: What is the common English name for 'Tadasana'?
Which yogic pose helps improve balance by standing on one leg like a tree?
How should we breathe during breathing exercises (Pranayama)?
options: Fast and loudly through the mouth
Slowly and deeply through the nose
Holding our breath until we feel dizzy
items.answer: Slowly and deeply through the nose

items.question: What is the correct posture when sitting at a desk to study?
options: Keeping your back straight and shoulders relaxed
items.answer: Keeping your back straight and shoulders relaxed

items.question: Which daily habit is best for your health and well-being?
options: Washing hands regularly and eating fresh food
Watching television all day without moving
items.answer: Washing hands regularly and eating fresh food
